name: bodyweight standing around the world (wall supported)
description: A standing arm circle against a wall that mobilises the shoulders while keeping your back from compensating.
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet slightly forward.
Start with arms straight down at your sides, palms forward.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and overhead in a wide arc, staying close to the wall.
Lower them back down the same way.
Keep your ribs and head against the wall.
